page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 1.85 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps and does not include any graphics processing units. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing raw CPU capacity and network throughput over local disk I/O and hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c6t.13xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute resources relative to its memory allocation, making it a viable option for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads for this instance profile include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive enterprise applications.
